headline: Public hearing on street acceptance for Juliana Avenue, plus a vote on all-way stop signs at French Street and Abbott Street.
summary: The committee will hold a public hearing on accepting Juliana Avenue as a street and consider ordinance O-26-024 to add stop signs at French Street and Abbott Street. It will also review tabled ordinances on camping and recreational vehicles on public property, and get an update on the Mohawk Tannery Project Remediation.
items: Public hearing: Petition for Street Acceptance - Juliana Avenue
Discussion: Update on the Mohawk Tannery Project Remediation
Communication from Wayne R. Husband, P.E., Senior Traffic Engineer, on Division of Public Works support of pending legislation (O-26-024)
Unfinished business O-26-024: Authorizing additional stop signs to make an all-way stop at French Street and Abbott Street
Petition for Street Acceptance: Juliana Avenue
Tabled in committee O-26-004: Repealing the prohibition on camping on public property (tabled at 4/22/26 meeting)
Tabled in committee O-26-005: Repealing the prohibition on campers and recreational vehicles on public property (tabled at 4/22/26 meeting)
Petition - L Deerwood Drive - Lot H-103 (tabled at 2/28/24 meeting)
